subject.title: feat(memorySearch): Support multimodal embedding with gemini-embedding-2-preview

question: Should OpenClaw core extend memorySearch beyond image/audio extraPaths to PDF/video files, remembered inbound attachments, or both, and what consent/retention boundary should apply?
rationale: The remaining work changes public memory configuration and can persist or upload private media to a remote embedding provider, so automation cannot choose the product and security boundary.

options.title: Split PDF/video from attachments
options.body: Add a narrow PDF/video `extraPaths` contract first, and track remembered inbound attachments as a separate product/security design.

options.title: Do full remembered-media design
options.body: Keep this issue as the broad tracker until maintainers define one end-to-end media retention, deletion, and embedding-upload contract.

options.title: Keep current subset only
options.body: Close or narrow the issue if maintainers decide image/audio extraPaths are the only supported Gemini multimodal memory surface for now.

recommendation.title: Split PDF/video from attachments
recommendation.body: Add a narrow PDF/video `extraPaths` contract first, and track remembered inbound attachments as a separate product/security design.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the shipped multimodal memory subset and are the clearest owner for deciding whether to extend that contract.
